about: Dataset registry for BroccoliDetect. Each entry pins one immutable dataset version stored in the team's Azure Blob container, so every model version in backend/weights/registry.json can point back to the exact images it was trained and evaluated on. See data/README.md for the add-a-version procedure.

versions.description: RGB field images from Deliverable B: the RGB channel of the original RGB-D capture, annotated with broccoli crown bounding boxes.
versions.notes: The null fields are unknown until the dataset is archived, because the source images live in the Deliverable B training repo, not here. Only the 27-image test split is certain today. When zipping the dataset, run scripts/data/make_manifest.py (directory mode for the per-file checksums, --archive mode for the zip digest), then fill in archive_sha256, num_images, and the train/val split sizes, and replace the <team-storage-account> placeholder with the real account name.
